name: Enchanted Hearts
source:
After witnessing a handsome stranger in peril, you rush to save him, only to unleash a magical power you never knew you had. Little did you know, you're actually part of a bloodline of powerful witches and warlocks. Soon after, you receive an invitation to attend Nocturne Academy, a school for supernatural beings, to help you master your newfound abilities. However, you soon find yourself caught in the middle of an ancient feud between werewolves and vampires.

To make matters more complicated, you've caught the eye of the hotheaded werewolf Lucius, a mysterious vampire—the very one you rescued when you discovered your power—named Valentin, and a malicious cult that wants to harness your power. Will you, alongside your companions, be able to work together and stop a war from breaking out as tensions continue to skyrocket? And will you find love amidst the magic and chaos?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.supernaturalschool]Google Play[/url]]
